analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price($67.93) vs SMA5/20/50($69.06/$70.63/$70.72): Below short-term/mid-term moving averages, indicating bearishness.
· Position vs SMA100/200($73.01/$62.06): Mixed long-term trend, above SMA200 confirms long-term support.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (49.9→42.5): Entering oversold territory, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.0116→-0.3873): Bearish crossover and worsening, signaling strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $70.63): Trading near the mid-band, with an 8.55% band width contraction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($71.76): Based on the 5-day high, above current price.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (No Higher Low formed, Lower High formed): Continuation of bearish pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.30x): Increased volume, but insufficient for trend reversal confirmation.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Lack of trend, conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach met.
